pages.title: Introduction
pages.content:
## Welcome to the Sakagura

A sakagura is a Japanese sake brewery, and ours is open to everyone. Brew sake, shochu, whisky, wine, gin, tea and many more drinks, and grow the barley, hops, grapes and fruit they need. A good brewer follows the recipe and is rewarded with up to five stars. No mods needed.

### What you will do

* **Grow.** Forty-eight garden crops - from barley and hops to yuzu, mangoes and dragon fruit - plus five orchard trees, wild or on your own farmland.
* **Brew.** A cauldron with heat cooks, a cold one mixes. Add the ingredients, wait the right number of real minutes, and bottle the result.
* **Distill and age.** Some drinks need a Steam Still, and others years in a cask. Casks age in real time, even while you are offline.
* **Enjoy (carefully).** Drinks give effects, but alcohol also makes you drunk. Drink too much and you pass out and wake up with a hangover.

### How the pages are organised

**Sakagura** has the step-by-step brewing guide. **Garden** lists the crops and where they grow, and **Recipes** has every drink with its steps. The [Sakagura guide](/sakagura) on this website explains each step in plain language, with a quality calculator.

### Good to know first

* A bottle always tells you its next step, so you never lose track.
* Some recipes use Kitchen ingredients or Steamworks plates, so the plugins work together.
* Not sure what a drink needs? **/zukan** shows every recipe with its steps.

### Start here

1. Read [Sakagura](/wiki?page=sakagura) and brew your first drink in a cauldron.
2. Plant some crops from the [Garden](/wiki?page=sakagura-garden).
3. Pick a drink from the [Recipes](/wiki?page=sakagura-recipes) and aim for five stars.

pages.title: Sakagura
pages.content:
## Sakagura - brewing

Brew sake, shochu, whisky, wine, gin, tea and much more. The better you follow a recipe, the better the drink: up to five stars. You only need the normal game - no mods.

### How to brew

1. **Cauldron.** Fill a cauldron with water. Put **heat under it** (fire, campfire, lava, magma or a lit furnace) to **cook**, or leave it cold to **mix**.
2. **Ingredients.** Right-click the cauldron with each ingredient (one per click). Right-click with an empty hand to see what's inside and for how long it has been going.
3. **Wait.** Every recipe has its own time in real minutes - too short or too long lowers the quality.
4. **Bottle it.** Right-click with a **glass bottle**: one cauldron gives three bottles.
5. **Distill** (some recipes): put the bottles and a **glowstone dust** in a **Steam Still** and give it **heat from below**. Every round uses one glowstone and is one distill run.
6. **Age** (some recipes): put the bottles in a **Sake Cask**. They age in real time - also while you're away. One year is 20 minutes. Many recipes want a certain wood.

A bottle that isn't finished yet says so ("Unfinished Sake - Next: age it 2 years in spruce"), so you always know the next step. A brew that matches nothing turns into a **Murky Brew**.

### Steam Still

Craft a still from a barrel, 2 iron ingots, blaze powder and a glowstone dust (all together in any order in a crafting grid). Put the bottles inside, add **glowstone dust** and place **fire, lava, a campfire or a lit furnace under it**: every 20 seconds one glowstone is spent and the bottles inside get one distill run. A hopper can feed bottles in and collect them, so the still fits in a line. Right-clicking the still tells you what it is doing.

### Sake Casks

Craft a cask from 6 planks of one wood and 2 iron nuggets (planks around, nuggets top and bottom in the middle). There is one for every wood - oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, cherry, mangrove, bamboo - and a steampunk **copper cask** (copper ingots and iron ingots). A cask works like a barrel: hoppers can fill and empty it.

### Drinking

Drinks give their effects - better quality, stronger good effects and milder bad ones. Alcohol makes you **drunk**: you stumble, the world sways, your chat gets slurred, too much makes you throw up, and if you overdo it you pass out and wake up at your spawn point with a hangover. Check yourself with **/brew drunk**.

### Pages

* [Recipes](/wiki?page=sakagura-recipes) - every drink and how to make it
* [Garden](/wiki?page=sakagura-garden) - barley, hops, grapes, fruit trees and berries

Type **/brew** in game for a short help. The [Sakagura guide](/sakagura) on this website explains every step in plain language.

pages.title: Sakagura Garden
pages.content:
## Garden

Everything for brewing grows on **farmland**, in three stages. Plants need light, and bone meal speeds them up. Right-click a ripe plant to pick it: bushes, vines and dwarf fruit trees grow back for another pick; the grains and roots are dug up and replanted from the start. Every crop below has its own page with the numbers.

**Good to know:** hops, grapes, passion fruit and vanilla are thirsty - they only grow on wet farmland. Grains and roots (barley, rice, rye, maize, ginger, wasabi, daikon) are dug up whole and replanted. Wild bushes appear here and there in the world; break or pick them for your first seeds. Fruiting plants sometimes drop their pit or seeds when picked, and one fruit crafts into two seeds. Many fruits are also nice to eat.

**Looking for bigger harvests?** The garden has an orchard too: [Orchard Trees](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees) grow from saplings into full trees whose fruit you pick off the canopy.

pages.title: Sakagura Recipes
pages.content:
## Recipes

Follow a recipe closely for the best quality (up to 5 stars). Cooking needs heat under the cauldron; mixing is done in a cauldron without heat. One minute means one real minute; one cask year is 20 real minutes.

| Drink | How to make it | Alcohol |
|---|---|---|
| Absinthe | Cook 3 min: 15 Grass -> Distill 6x | 42% |
| Sweet Apple Mead | Cook 4 min: 6 Sugar Cane, 2 Apple -> Age 4 years (oak cask) | 11% |
| Beer | Cook 8 min: 6 Wheat -> Age 3 years | 6% |
| Apple Cider | Cook 7 min: 14 Apple -> Age 3 years | 7% |
| Darkbeer | Cook 8 min: 6 Wheat -> Distill 3x | 7% |
| Eggnog | Cook 2 min: 5 Egg, 2 Sugar, 1 Milk Bucket -> Age 3 years | 10% |
| Golden Vodka | Cook 18 min: 10 Potato, 2 Gold Nugget -> Distill 3x | 20% |
| Gin | Cook 6 min: 9 Wheat, 6 Blue Orchid, 1 Apple -> Distill 2x | 20% |
| Hot Chocolate | Cook 2 min: 3 Cookie | - |
| Iced Coffee | Mix (no heat) 1 min: 8 Cookie, 4 Snowball, 1 Milk Bucket | - |
| Potato soup | Cook 3 min: 5 Potato, 3 Short Grass | - |
| Spicy Rum | Cook 6 min: 18 Sugar Cane -> Distill 2x -> Age 14 years (oak cask) | 30% |
| Tequila | Cook 15 min: 8 Cactus -> Distill 2x -> Age 12 years (birch cask) | 20% |
| Vodka | Cook 15 min: 10 Potato -> Distill 3x | 20% |
| Whiskey | Cook 10 min: 10 Wheat -> Distill 2x -> Age 18 years (spruce cask) | 26% |
| Brandy | Cook 5 min: 5 Sweet Berries -> Distill 4x -> Age 12 years (dark oak cask) | 35% |
| Apple Juice | Cook 6 min: 9 Apple, 6 Sugar | - |
| Red Sangria | Mix (no heat) 4 min: 1 Red Wine, 1 Apple Liquor, 1 Brandy, 6 Sugar, 1 Apple -> Age 1 years (copper cask) | 25% |
| French 75 | Mix (no heat) 3 min: 1 Apple Juice, 2 Gin, 4 Sugar | 20% |
| Sake | Cook 8 min: 6 Steamed Rice, 1 Sugar -> Age 2 years (spruce cask) | 15% |
| Nigori Sake | Cook 6 min: 5 Steamed Rice, 2 Sugar | 12% |
| Shochu | Cook 7 min: 6 Barley, 2 Potato -> Distill 2x | 25% |
| Umeshu | Mix (no heat) 3 min: 6 Ume, 4 Sugar, 1 Shochu -> Age 3 years (cherry cask) | 14% |
| Yuzu Chuhai | Mix (no heat) 2 min: 3 Yuzu, 2 Sugar, 1 Shochu | 8% |
| Momo Sake | Mix (no heat) 2 min: 4 Peach, 1 Sake -> Age 1 years (birch cask) | 10% |
| Sakura Liqueur | Cook 5 min: 6 Cherry, 3 Sugar, 4 Pink Petals -> Distill 1x -> Age 2 years (cherry cask) | 18% |
| Steam Whisky | Cook 10 min: 10 Barley -> Distill 3x -> Age 8 years (copper cask) | 32% |
| Hop Ale | Cook 6 min: 6 Barley, 3 Hops -> Age 2 years (oak cask) | 6% |
| Red Wine | Cook 6 min: 8 Grape -> Age 4 years (oak cask) | 12% |
| Juniper Gin | Cook 5 min: 6 Juniper, 1 Ginger, 3 Wheat -> Distill 3x | 30% |
| Berry Wine | Cook 5 min: 4 Blueberry, 4 Strawberry, 2 Sugar -> Age 2 years (birch cask) | 10% |
| Apple Liquor | Cook 5 min: 6 Apple, 2 Sugar -> Distill 2x | 25% |
| Bloody Mary | Cook 3 min: 15 Red Dye, 12 Potato -> Distill 8x | 42% |
| Zombie Zeste Zinger | Cook 12 min: 5 Steamed Rice, 2 Sugar | 80% |
| Shamrock Shake | Cook 4 min: 4 Barley, 1 Milk Bucket, 1 Glow Berries, 2 Sugar | 9% |

pages.title: Orchard Trees
pages.content:
## Orchard Trees

Sakagura 0.5.0 added real trees to the garden. A sapling is planted with a right-click on grass or dirt (not farmland - trees take a spot of their own) and grows in three stages: a sprout, a young tree and a full tree. Each step takes about twenty minutes of real time; bone meal on the trunk skips one.


* [The five species](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees-the-five-species)
* [Picking and felling](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees-picking-and-felling)
* [Saplings](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees-saplings)

pages.title: The five species
pages.content:
| Tree | Fruit | Grown from | Good to know |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sakura | 2-4 Cherries | Cherry + 2 Sticks | Pink blossom; petals drift off the canopy |
| Ume Plum | 2-3 Ume Plums | Ume Plums + 2 Sticks | The sake fruit, off a tree instead of a bush |
| Apple | 2-4 Apples | Apples + 2 Sticks | A classic, with bigger yields than the bush |
| Orange | 2-4 Mikan Oranges | Mikan Oranges + 2 Sticks | Glossy green canopy |
| Red Maple | none | 2 Red Mushrooms + 2 Sticks | Pure decoration - golden sparkles in autumn colours |
| Cherry | 2-4 Cherries | Cherries + 2 Sticks | A smaller, denser canopy than the sakura |
| Peach | 2-3 Peaches | Peaches + 2 Sticks | Pink blossoms, fuzzy fruit |
| Lemon | 2-4 Yuzu | Yuzu + 2 Sticks | Glossy dark canopy, tart fruit |
| Fig | 2-3 Figs | Figs + 2 Sticks | Broad leaves, sweet purple fruit |
| Walnut | none | Olives + 2 Sticks | Pure decoration - broad canopy, no fruit |

Back to [Orchard Trees](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees)

pages.title: Picking and felling
pages.content:
* A ripe tree shows fruit dots in its top canopy. Right-click the trunk and 2-4 pieces of fruit drop - the canopy then ripens again in about twenty minutes.
* Punch the trunk three times and the tree comes down; you get the sapling back (plus any fruit that was hanging). Trees need four blocks of air above them and a little space from their neighbours.
* The fruit is the same fruit the bush version gives, so every drink recipe works with tree fruit too - and vice versa.

Back to [Orchard Trees](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees)

pages.title: Saplings
pages.content:
One craft: the tree's own fruit (or two red mushrooms for the maple) plus two sticks in any arrangement. Fruiting trees can also be bonemealed as saplings to speed them up. Wild trees do not spawn - an orchard is something you plant.

Back to [Orchard Trees](/wiki?page=sakagura-trees)

pages.title: Brewing Competitions
pages.content:
## Brewing Competitions

From time to time, the server hosts a brewing competition. Players submit their best drinks, and the highest quality brews win prizes.


* [How it works](/wiki?page=sakagura-competitions-how-it-works)
* [Commands](/wiki?page=sakagura-competitions-commands)
* [Tips](/wiki?page=sakagura-competitions-tips)

pages.title: How it works
pages.content:
1. **An admin starts a competition** with `/brew comp start <days> [theme]`. The theme is optional (e.g. "bloody_mary" for a themed competition, or "any" for all drinks).
2. **Players brew their best drink** and submit it while holding it: `/brew comp submit`.
3. **Each submission is scored** based on quality (1-10 stars) and difficulty (1-10). Score = quality × 10 + difficulty × 5.
4. **Only your best submission counts** — if you submit a better drink, it replaces your previous one.
5. **When the competition ends** (admin runs `/brew comp stop` or the timer runs out), the top 3 players receive rewards:
   - 1st place: $500 + 20 elite coins + "Master of the Still" title
   - 2nd place: $250 + 10 elite coins + "Skilled Brewer" title
   - 3rd place: $100 + 5 elite coins + "Rising Brewer" title
6. **The winner** also earns the "Master of the Still" advancement.

Back to [Brewing Competitions](/wiki?page=sakagura-competitions)

pages.title: Commands
pages.content:
| Command | Who | What |
|---|---|---|
| `/brew comp status` | Everyone | Show if a competition is running and time remaining |
| `/brew comp submit` | Everyone | Submit the drink you're holding |
| `/brew comp leaderboard` | Everyone | Show the current top 10 |
| `/brew comp start <days> [theme]` | Admin | Start a competition (1-30 days) |
| `/brew comp stop` | Admin | End the competition and give rewards |

Back to [Brewing Competitions](/wiki?page=sakagura-competitions)

pages.title: Tips
pages.content:
- **Quality matters most** — a 10-star drink scores 100 points, while a 5-star scores 50. Aim for perfect recipes.
- **Difficulty adds bonus** — harder recipes (difficulty 8-10) give up to 50 extra points.
- **Theme competitions** — when a theme is set, only that specific drink counts. This levels the playing field.
- **Practice first** — use `/brew recipes` to see all drinks and their difficulty, then brew the perfect one.
- **You can resubmit** — if you brew a better version, submit again. Only your best counts.

Back to [Brewing Competitions](/wiki?page=sakagura-competitions)

pages.title: Seasons
pages.content:
## Seasons

The Sakagura garden follows the seasons. Every 7 real days, the season changes, affecting which crops grow and how fast.


* [The four seasons](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons-the-four-seasons)
* [How it works](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons-how-it-works)
* [Commands](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons-commands)
* [Tips](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons-tips)

pages.title: The four seasons
pages.content:
| Season | Duration | Growing crops | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Spring** | 7 days | Cherry, Ume, Peach, Strawberry, Apricot, Mikan, Kiwi, Tomato, Raspberry, Gooseberry | Cherry blossoms and fresh growth |
| **Summer** | 7 days | Yuzu, Mango, Papaya, Guava, Rambutan, Longan, Mangosteen, Dragon Fruit, Passion Fruit, Vanilla, Chili, Maize, Tomato | Lush growth and tropical fruits |
| **Autumn** | 7 days | Grape, Apple, Pear, Persimmon, Loquat, Pomegranate, Fig, Quince, Olive, Date, Lychee, Elderberry, Cranberry, Mulberry, Barley, Rye, Hops | Harvest time and falling leaves |
| **Winter** | 7 days | Ginger, Wasabi, Daikon, Rice, Juniper, Blueberry, Blackcurrant, Strawberry | Dormant gardens and hardy crops |

Back to [Seasons](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons)

pages.title: How it works
pages.content:
- **Seasons advance automatically** every 7 real days (configurable). A broadcast announces the change.
- **In-season crops** grow at normal speed.
- **Out-of-season crops** grow 30-70% slower (they're not meant for this season).
- **Wild spawns** only include crops for the current season.
- **Admins** can force a season change with `/brew season set <spring|summer|autumn|winter>`.

Back to [Seasons](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons)

pages.title: Commands
pages.content:
| Command | Who | What |
|---|---|---|
| `/brew season status` | Everyone | Show current season and time until next |
| `/brew season list` | Everyone | List all seasons with their crops |
| `/brew season crops` | Everyone | Show which crops grow this season |
| `/brew season set <season>` | Admin | Force a season change |

Back to [Seasons](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons)

pages.title: Tips
pages.content:
- **Plan ahead** — plant crops that will be in-season soon
- **Winter is for hardy crops** — ginger, wasabi, daikon, rice, and juniper thrive
- **Seasonal drinks** — some recipes taste better with seasonal ingredients
- **Competition themes** — admins can run themed competitions per season

Back to [Seasons](/wiki?page=sakagura-seasons)
